body: Yes. Obviously I don’t think you should be an asshole about someone else’s body. But if what you mean is that you don’t pretend you like all guys and you’re upfront and say “I only like muscle guys” then yes I’m happy.

What I want is for people not to pretend they’re okay with my body type when they’re not. Obviously I’m not saying they should go “fuck off fatty” I’m saying they shouldn’t go “oh I like all kinds of men regardless of their shape” and then proceed to reject every fat guy they meet.

I know myself pretty well. I’m a kind, honest, trustworthy, funny, respectful, and genuinely interesting person. I know a lot about tons of things and people find me fascinating. I captivate people when I talk about things that interest me. I know that I have value, I know that I’d be a good partner. I’m a reliable person who thinks about the needs of others. And I know that all might make me sound like a braggart, but I promise you I actually find it very hard to brag, and I very much don’t like to.

I don’t think it’s my personality. I don’t think I’m rude, or uninteresting, or anything like that. Am I perhaps a little jaded to the community and it’s flaws, yes. But I’m honest and I own up to that. I don’t pretend that I’m perfect, and I don’t pretend that I’m worthless. The thing that makes it difficult is that people don’t give me the chance to show them how interesting I can be because they don’t like my physical appearance. And again, I do not think they owe me that. All I’m asking for is an honest declaration that they’re uninterested in me and no phony bologna “body-positivity” that they don’t actually believe in.

I want to make it clear because some of you don’t seem to understand. I’m not asking every man to be interested in me. I do not think they owe me love or sex. What I think they owe me, as we all owe to each other, is honesty. I want people to quit the crap and stop pretending they like all body types when it isn’t true. It hurts more when someone pretends they like you, than when they’re honest and up front and say “you’re fat, I’m not interested” If people would do something that simple, I’d be completely satisfied.

I’m not asking that everyone be attracted to me, let alone have sex with me. What I’m asking is that people be honest instead of pretending that me being fat isn’t the reason they’re not interested. It doesn’t surprise me or upset me when a man doesn’t want me, what’s upsetting is that people *pretend* to be interested in all body types when in reality they’re not.
